Prevention: Harvesting maize cobs when they are ready (to reduce infestation of maize cob in the field)
Dry maize grain properly till it is very dry (humidity of 13)
Good hygiene (store maize in a clean & well ventilated store)
Separate old from new grain stocks
Clean your store before putting in newly harvested maize
Store in small silos or big container with tight lids
Store maize in super grain bags (bags lined with 2 or 3 thick plastic bags tightly tied to keep air out)
Monitoring: Stock inspection (once a week) using spear sampling
Check for damage symptoms (grain with holes)
Take action when signs of infestation are observed
Direct Control: Winnowing, sieving or sifting infested grains
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
Permethrin (Skana super) at the rate of 2,5 kg per 1 ton of grain or
Agrothrin at rate of 1.5 kg/ton of maize, mix insecticide and maize thoroughly and keep it in a dry area.
Allow store to aerate before re- entering.
